STONE RING IN THE PINE HOLLOW: a hollow ringed by mossy boulders, a fat little dome tent with a crooked pole beside it, a ring of flat stones holding a stacked campfire, a copper kettle hanging from a leaning iron tripod, tall pines pressing close behind, glowing moss threading between the boulder gaps

DRIFTWOOD FIRE ON THE BLACK SAND: a long crescent of black sand curving between two headlands, a wigwam stack of driftwood with a fire burning at its heart, a tubby overturned rowboat drawn up behind it, a carved wooden gull fixed to the keel, dune grass ridging the dark bank behind

LANTERN BRIDGE OVER THE SLOW RIVER: a low arched plank bridge over a wide slow river, bulbous round paper lanterns strung along both rails on short bamboo poles, a little shrine hut with a fish-painted shutter sitting on the far reed bank, a plank landing below the arch

FIRE PIT ON THE ROCKY BLUFF: a flat shelf of bare rock above a drop, a shallow fire pit ringed with split stones, a canvas tarp slung between two crooked poles above it, a tin cup sitting on a flat stone beside the pit, a scatter of oversized toadstools at the bluff edge

REED BANK LANTERN FLOAT: a slow river curving between tall reed banks, a short plank landing jutting from the bank, round leaf-painted paper lanterns set adrift from its edge, a woven basket sitting open at the landing's foot, reeds leaning in thick bundles on both sides

BIRCH CLEARING CAMPFIRE: a round hollow inside a ring of slim birch trunks, a stacked log fire burning between two mossy boulders, a pair of rolled bedrolls laid to one side, a carved wooden owl fixed to a short post at the hollow's edge, pale bracket fungi stepping up the nearest birch

MOUNTAIN STONE HUT ON THE RIDGE: a stubby stone hut with a hat-shaped roof sitting on a narrow ridge, an iron brazier on a flat stone beside the door, the door itself hung with a rope of wooden beads, short bent grass pressed flat around the hut, bare rock falling away on both sides

TALL-GRASS MEADOW LANTERN: a wide meadow of tall swaying grass split by a crooked timber fence, a single round paper lantern hung from a leaning post at the fence's mid-point, a woven basket set against the post's base, a garden of huge pale night flowers blooming along the fence line

BONFIRE IN THE BOULDER COVE: a small cove with walls of stacked dark rock rising on three sides, a driftwood bonfire built in the centre of the shingle floor, a fat dome tent wedged between two boulders behind it, a carved wooden fish hung from an iron ring fixed into a crevice above

TUBBY BOAT ON STILL WATER: a tubby wooden fishing boat sitting on a flat calm lake, a round lantern hung from a bent iron hook at the bow, a carved bear fixed to the bow below the hook, the hull painted plain with a single circle on each side, a low reed bed ringing the near shore

TIMBER MOUNTAIN REFUGE WITH FIRE PIT: a square-shouldered timber refuge hut on a broad alpine ledge, a shallow stone-edged fire pit burning in front of the door, a pair of heavy boots standing at the door frame, a stack of split logs piled against the hut wall beside a carved wooden axe handle

STEPPED LANE WITH PAPER LANTERNS: a narrow stepped lane climbing between old close-set timber houses, round paper lanterns on short brackets fixed to the house walls at every other step, a little arched timber gate at the lane's top, a copper kettle sitting on the gatepost cap, potted ferns on the lower steps

FIRE BETWEEN THE BOULDERS: a pine-hemmed hollow with two tall boulders leaning toward each other, a campfire burning in the gap between them, a leaning kettle tripod over the fire, two bedrolls spread on the ground, a rope of dried leaves hanging from the closer boulder's face

LANTERNS ON THE RIVER CURVE: a wide slow river bending in a long curve, bulbous circle-painted paper lanterns drifting in a loose chain along the current, a little shrine hut on a low bank with a leaf-painted shutter, a plank path leading down from the hut to the water's edge

MARSH BOARDWALK LAMP: a long bowed timber boardwalk crossing a dark marsh, fat cattail reeds rising on both sides, a round lamp in a tin hood fixed to a short post at the boardwalk's far end, a tin cup on the flat rail beside the post, clumps of oversized toadstools dotting the marsh around the walk

SHEPHERD HUT UNDER THE ROCK FACE: a low shepherd's hut with a turf roof pressed against a sheer rock face, a round lamp on an iron hook fixed into the stone above the door, a carved wooden ram fixed to the door lintel, flat stones forming a small yard in front, short heather filling every crack in the yard

PEBBLE BEACH ROWBOAT FIRE: a wide pebble beach with a gentle curve, an overturned tubby rowboat pulled above the tide line, a campfire burning on a flat stone slab in front of it, a carved wooden gull fixed to the upturned keel, a low dune of beach grass behind the boat

WILDFLOWER HOLLOW LANTERN: a shallow bowl of a hollow thick with wildflowers, a single round lantern hung from a bent iron arm on a timber post at the centre, a woven basket hanging below the lantern arm, huge night flowers with broad pale petals growing in a ring around the post

PUNT AMONG THE REEDS: a flat-bottomed punt resting in a reed channel on a still lake, a round lamp in a tin frame fixed to a short pole at the prow, a woven mat folded over the punt's middle bench, tall reeds forming a close corridor on both sides, lily pads flat on the water ahead

ALLEY LANTERN GATE: a narrow stone alley between two high render walls, round paper lanterns on iron wall brackets every few paces, a little low arched gate of timber planks at the alley's end, a carved wooden cat fixed to the gate's arch, mossy cobbles running the full length underfoot

HARBOUR LIGHT ON THE JETTY: a stubby harbour lighthouse at the end of a long bowed plank jetty on pilings, its lamp room lit behind small square panes, a hanging bundle of dried herbs by its door, a coil of thick rope on the last plank, barnacled pilings dropping into still harbour water below

BLUFF TARP CAMP WITH FIRE: a rocky bluff above a valley, a shallow pit fire ringed with pale stones at the bluff's flat edge, a canvas tarp slung at an angle on two poles above the pit, a copper kettle on a flat stone beside the fire, a carved wooden hawk fixed to the forward pole's tip

ROUND-SHOULDERED LIGHTHOUSE ON THE HEADLAND: a round-shouldered lighthouse leaning slightly on a bare rock headland, its lamp room glowing behind thick glass, a low stone wall curving around the base, a tin cup on the wall cap beside the door, glowing moss filling the cracks between the wall stones

CIRCLE-LANTERN LANE WITH ARCH: a stepped cobblestone lane between close timber-framed houses, large round paper lanterns with a single leaf painted on each one strung overhead on a cord from eave to eave, a small arched plank gate at the bottom step, a rope of wooden beads looped over the gate's latch post

STACKED-LOG FIRE BY THE LAKE SHELF: a flat shelf of grass sitting above a still lake, a stacked log campfire burning inside a ring of rounded stones, a fat little dome tent with a crooked pole behind it, a pair of boots standing at the tent flap, glowing moss spreading in a soft ring between the outermost stones
